steps: Check the status of the new pods for the 'intake-api' deployment using: kubectl -n dip-data get pods -l app=intake-api
Inspect the logs or describe the failing pods to understand why they aren't becoming ready: kubectl -n dip-data logs <pod-name> --previous or kubectl -n dip-data describe pod <pod-name>
Perform a rollback of the deployment to return to the previous version: python -m dip rollback intake-api

_gemini_part.text:
The incident was caused by a platform release failure. The rollout for the `intake-api` deployment in the `dip-data` namespace stalled because the new version failed to progress within the allotted time, as indicated by the Kubernetes event: `ReplicaSet "intake-api-6f8b9c7d54" has timed out progressing`.

I have proposed steps grounded in runbook `13-bad-release` to investigate the failure and perform a rollback.
